Field services bulletin

This bulletin summarises the quarter's inspection results and the changes to reporting that follow from them. It is circulated to all regional coordinators and to the compliance desk.

Reports submitted after the fifteenth of the month are carried into the following period and do not count toward the current quarter's totals.

Inspection summary

Coverage improved across every region except the northern corridor, where two scheduled visits were deferred at the operator's request. Both have been rebooked within the following period.

Region A — 41 visits
Region B — 38 visits
Region C — 29 visits

Deferred visits are not failures, but a deferral that is not rebooked within thirty days becomes one.

Reporting changes

From the next cycle, the site reference and the operator reference are both required on submission. Reports missing either are returned automatically.

  • Site reference is now mandatory on every form
  • Operator reference replaces the free-text operator field
  • Photographs are retained for twenty-four months

Queries about the new fields should go to the compliance desk before the cycle opens, not after a report has been returned.

INTERNAL CIRCULATION ONLY
